text.title: Twofold Assault
text.body: Two black fortress towers—West Crag and East Crag—straddle a mile-deep volcanic chasm, commanding the lone approach to the Infernal Citadel. Storm both bastions across swaying stone causeways and crush their reserve counter-charge.
text.obj.0: Storm and clear the West Crag Bastion
text.obj.1: Storm and clear the East Crag Bastion
text.msg.1: Twin black crags straddle the abyss. Burn both bastions—the moment one falls, expect an armored counter-charge across the stone causeways!
text.msg.2: West Crag Bastion falls—allied standards whip in the thermal gale!
text.msg.4: One crag has fallen—the opposing bastion's armored reserve column charges down the flank!
text.win: Allied banners fly over both Twin Crags and the abyssal causeway is crossed.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell beneath the Twin Crags.
